outcome: recruitment costs (total cost, cost per click, link clicks, paid impressions, cost per survey)
cohort: Emerging adults assigned female at birth (n=245 completed survey, n=24 completed follow-up interviews).
finding: Social media and ResearchMatch are both successful recruitment tools, but each offers distinct benefits for recruiting specific emerging adult populations, differing in enrollment rates, participant demographics (age, education, race), and recruitment costs.
